$comment: Replace 'your-org' with your real Git host/org. Entries still pointing at 'your-org' are treated as unconfigured placeholders: they are skipped with a notice instead of failing setup, so a fresh clone of this example workspace runs green out of the box. `localPath` and `projectId` are read by the agent skills, not by the setup scripts: `localPath` is where the repo lands on disk (`path` + `name`), and `projectId` is the GitLab project id the MCP tools address it by. A skill must NEVER guess a project id — a wrong one posts comments on, or pushes to, a stranger's repository.
